note: Re-judged independently at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 4.3 ("For well-known attributes and for optional non-transitive attributes, the Partial bit MUST be set to 0.") after 89250c6db8 restored RFC4271-5-3 negative comment lines without altering test assertions. Positive: attribute.TestRFC4271PartialBitClearOnSend asserts Flags().IsPartial()==false and encoded buf[0]&0x20==0 for all five RFC 4271 well-known attributes (ORIGIN, AS_PATH, NEXT_HOP, LOCAL_PREF, ATOMIC_AGGREGATE) and optional non-transitive MED; reactor.TestRFC4271PartialClearedOnTheRelayedWire (revert discrimination record on attribute.ClearPartialOnWellKnownAndNonTransitive) drives enforceRFC7606 -> publishBase -> RelayStoredRoute to an RS-client with incoming ORIGIN 0x60, MED 0xA0, COMMUNITIES 0xE0 and asserts exact relayed flags 0x40, 0x80, and preserved 0xE0; reactor.TestRFC4271PartialNotSetOnRecognizedOrNonTransitive asserts clean ORIGIN 0x40, MED 0x80, COMMUNITIES 0xC0 remain 0x40, 0x80, 0xC0 through enforceRFC7606/publishBase. Negative: rib.TestRFC4271PartialClearedWhenTheRailReadvertises (revert discrimination record on packAttributesWithASPath) parses incoming Partial-set ORIGIN 0x60, MED 0xA0, LOCAL_PREF 0x60 via AttributesWire.All and asserts exact packed iBGP flags 0x40, 0x40, 0x80; storage.TestRFC4271PartialBitClearedOnReadvertisedWellKnown parses ORIGIN 0x60, LOCAL_PREF 0x60, MED 0xA0 via ParseAttributes -> ToWireBytes and asserts exact 0x40, 0x40, 0x80; attribute.TestRFC4271PartialNotStampedOnExcludedClasses asserts SetPartialOnUnrecognizedTransitive stamps 0 attributes and leaves ORIGIN 0x40, MED 0x80, COMMUNITIES 0xC0 byte-identical.
